headlines.title: Mario Draghi hints at ECB rate cut to avoid deflation
E.C.B. Plots Strategy for Staving Off Deflation
headlines.abstract: As the bank’s president, Mario Draghi, acknowledged to a group of experts that the euro zone might slide into deflation, good options are scarce.

headlines.title: Euro Zone Edges Closer to Dreaded Deflation
headlines.abstract: Consumer prices in the 18 nations of the euro zone rose at an annual rate of just 0.5 percent in May, further pressuring the European Central Bank to ease monetary policy.

headlines.title: ECB's justified action will help but is no panacea for eurozone deflationary ills
ECB unleashes €400bn lending programme and negative interest rates - as it happened
